author: Pixar
description:
Welcome to Pixar!! We're sharing a variety of stuff directly from us (the filmmakers at Pixar)! We're going behind the scenes with artists, showing exclusive new short films, and sharing never-before-seen secrets from our movies! 

This week's guests include the team behind HOPPERS! Daniel Chong (Director), Madeline Sharafian (Story Supervisor), and John Cody Kim (Story Supervisor), as well as @pixar, Cuddles' Corner, and the world premiere of the Pixar artist short film, LIGHTBULB! Don't miss it! And don't forget to check out Disney/Pixar's HOPPERS, now in theaters!
